title: Real Numbers
summary: Grade 9: terminating and recurring decimals, irrational numbers like √2 and π, the real number line, and working with surds.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Representing numbers in different forms reveals that some quantities, like √2, can never be written as fractions.

factual: When does a fraction have a terminating decimal?
conceptual: How can we prove that √2 is irrational?
Why does every point on the number line correspond to a real number?

cbseChapters: Class 9 Ganita Manjari (2026): The World of Numbers
